corrections.title: Add Reva (setup) and Great Mothers (conditional cleanup) multi-battle steps to 5v5 The Stranger (#112, #115)
corrections.rationale: Owner-approved scope of #112 (option A only) and #115: show Reva / Inquisitors as a deliberate first-battle weakening attempt and Great Mothers as a conditional cleanup win against a pre-weakened four-defender Stranger remnant, without a fabricated tier, banner score, undersize or win rate. Uses the new tactical matchup role (SETUP / CLEANUP) added in the same pull request: such entries carry only counterId, role and notes, are shown in a separate Multi-battle options section, and are never ranked, allocated or projected by Round Mode. The six existing one-shot rows keep their order and scores. Because both steps live on the same row, the two issues form one proposal; #112's decision covers the Reva step and #115's the Great Mothers step and the shared representation.

evidence.supports: One user-reported 5v5 battle: Reva / Inquisitors eliminated one The Stranger defender and reduced the health of the others; not a win. Numerous Galactic Legend attempts against The Stranger have failed.
One user-reported 5v5 Great Mothers cleanup win against The Stranger with four defenders remaining, after the Reva / Inquisitors battle had eliminated one defender and weakened the others.

provenance.conditions: 5v5 only. Defence: The Stranger (exact members, omicrons and datacrons not reported). Setup: existing REVA definition (Third Sister, Grand Inquisitor, Seventh Sister). Cleanup: existing GREAT_MOTHERS definition (Great Mothers required); only after the setup battle has removed a defender and damaged the rest.
provenance.confidence: Low: one user-reported battle for each step.
provenance.limitations: No win rate, banner result, sample size or repeatability for either step. The Great Mothers squad and the four remaining defenders were not recorded. Not evidence for a fresh-team Great Mothers or Reva win, for any other four-defender remnant, for 3v3 or for other defences. Existing The Stranger rows (JABBA, SATELE_SHAN, SEE, JMK, SEE_BANE, THE_STRANGER) unchanged.

runtimeImpact.5v5: The Stranger gains two multi-battle steps shown only in Counters: Reva (Setup) and Great Mothers (Cleanup), with no tier, banners or undersize. One-shot counters and their order and scores are unchanged.
runtimeImpact.counters: 5v5 The Stranger shows a Multi-battle options section after its one-shot counters: Reva as a weakening battle and Great Mothers as a conditional cleanup.
runtimeImpact.roundAvailability: none: Round allocation, Next Up, My Board recommendations and the Last Battle advisor never use the two steps; Mark Used still records Reva or Great Mothers as used.

counters.notes: Weakening battle only, not expected to win. In one user-reported 5v5 battle Reva (Inquisitors) defeated one Stranger defender and damaged the others. Use it to remove one or more defenders and wear down health or protection, then plan a second team to finish (see the Great Mothers cleanup). One battle only: no win rate, banner result or repeatability.

Conditional cleanup, not a fresh-team counter. One user-reported 5v5 win against four remaining Stranger defenders after a Reva (Inquisitors) setup battle had removed one and weakened the rest. Do not expect the same against a full-strength Stranger or an unweakened remnant. Great Mothers squad, the four remaining defenders and banners were not recorded.
